title: Singapore Air Show 2026
description: My first Air Show - shot on a Nikon Z6III + Tamron 150-600mm G2.

DSC_2163.png.title: Lines in the sky
DSC_2163.png.caption: Red wings and parallel smoke trails, drawn across a blue sky.
DSC_2163.png.alt: Red-and-white propeller aircraft flying in formation overhead, leaving parallel white smoke trails.

DSC_3318.png.title: In sync
DSC_3318.png.caption: Two aircraft, one rhythm.
DSC_3318.png.alt: Two red aerobatic aircraft flying parallel against a clear blue sky, each trailing white smoke.

DSC_3362.png.title: Cloud company
DSC_3362.png.caption: A little blue, a little cloud, and a perfectly matched pair.
DSC_3362.png.alt: Two red propeller aircraft flying one above the other beside soft white clouds in a vertical composition.

DSC_3598.png.title: On the ground
DSC_3598.png.caption: A quieter detail between the flying displays.
DSC_3598.png.alt: A grey aircraft tail marked 8319, with a black bird emblem and a chequered tip, against sunlit clouds.

DSC_3726.png.title: Four of a kind
DSC_3726.png.caption: A formation of four, threading smoke through the clouds.
DSC_3726.png.alt: Four red-and-yellow helicopters flying in a staggered formation with white smoke trailing behind.

DSC_3774.png.title: Side by side
DSC_3774.png.caption: Close company, a long way above the ground.
DSC_3774.png.alt: Two red-and-yellow display helicopters flying closely side by side, leaving white smoke trails.

DSC_3952.png.title: Banking into blue
DSC_3952.png.caption: One turn, caught against the open sky.
DSC_3952.png.alt: A grey fighter jet banking against a pale blue sky, its underside and swept wings visible.

DSC_4392.png.title: Arcs in the blue
DSC_4392.png.caption: White trails unfurl beneath a helicopter, briefly drawing on the sky.
DSC_4392.png.alt: A dark helicopter above a fan of curling white smoke trails against blue sky and scattered clouds.

DSC_4790.png.title: Shared airspace
DSC_4790.png.caption: Rotors, wings, and a ribbon of blue smoke in the same frame.
DSC_4790.png.alt: A military helicopter and a fighter jet together in the frame, with pale blue smoke trailing to the lower right.

DSC_4952.png.title: Rotor rhythm
DSC_4952.png.caption: A close look at the machine behind the movement.
DSC_4952.png.alt: Side view of a dark military helicopter in flight, with blurred rotor blades, landing wheels, and equipment beneath its wings.
